about: The epistola of the formulary “Mass of the First Sunday after Epiphany” in the 1962 Roman Missal. This formulary serves the weekdays of that week. On the Sunday itself the feast of the Holy Family takes its place.

seg.tr: Brethren: I beseech you by the mercy of God that ye present your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and pleasing unto God, your reasonable service. Be not conformed to this world, but be transformed in the newness of your mind, that ye may prove what is the will of God: good, acceptable, and perfect. By the grace that is given me, I say to every one among you not to think more highly than he ought to think, but to think soberly, according as God hath divided to every one the measure of faith. For as in one body we have many members, yet all the members have not the same office, so we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another, in Christ Jesus our Lord.
